spec2def(tapi32.dll tapi32.spec)

# tapi32.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/tapi32-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(tapi32_shims OBJECT assisted.c line.c phone.c)
target_link_libraries(tapi32_shims PRIVATE wine libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(tapi32_shims)
add_cargo_module(tapi32 tapi32-cargo tapi32.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS tapi32_shims psdk)
